info.title: QuickTap POS billing API
info.description:
Licence, device seats, catalogue and bills for one shop, shared by the Android till, a website and a desktop program.

**Two ways to authenticate.** The app sends `X-App-Id` + `X-Api-Key` and, after sign-in, `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. A website or desktop client sends a single `X-Api-Token: qt_pat_…` header, created per shop in the admin panel; it can be read-only.

**Every answer uses one envelope:** `{"success":bool,"message":string,"data":mixed,"code":string,"timestamp":ms}`. Branch on `code`, show `message`. An unknown code must be treated as a refusal: the app does.

**Money.** Totals of a bill written through `POST v1/bills` are calculated by the server from its lines, so no client can store an inconsistent bill. Stock of a sold product is decremented in the catalogue, and the till picks that up on its next sync.
